paragraphs: Hansen builds software for energy and communications service providers, aimed at getting new products to market and delivering them to customers. The catalog is split into two suites, one for energy and utilities and one for communications, technology and media. The company says it has served the utilities, energy and communications industries for more than fifty years.

The utility suite starts with a system that manages customer data, billing and service interactions. Meter data management collects, validates, stores and analyses metering data for billing accuracy and grid management. A market messaging component automates and secures the data exchange that regulated markets require. The telecom side is built on catalog-driven cloud applications for service providers.

Municipal utilities appear among the customers, including the City of Kinston, which upgraded its Hansen customer information system. Community solar is another described use, served with the customer information system plus managed services. The company has announced a partnership with ERTH Holdings to widen the reach of those systems.
